newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev firms to 3,050-3,100 per dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev firms to 3,050-3,100 per dlr at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev edged up to 3,050-3,100 per dollar at close from the morning's 3,100-3,150 in thin interbank trade, dealers said.
"(Dollar) supply from final clients rose slightly amid low demand, helping the lev to gain some 50 from the opening," one dealer said.
However, dealers said they saw the lev's firming as only a brief pause rather than a reversal in the underlying downward trend of the lev.

Banks were reluctant to sell dollars amid the deepening economic crisis and the lev was expected to resume its rapid fall once large final clients start bidding for foreign currency, traders said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
